check_box.label: Tell me when a new Charis Viewer is out (checked at start, once a day)
check_box.name: plus_update_check_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Off by default. When on, reads one small file from the update site (setting PlusUpdateCheckURL; nothing is read while it is empty) at most once a day, at start. As with any web page, the site keeps your IP address and the viewer's version in its log. Nothing about your account or avatar is sent.
